root: all file paths are relative to new-roguelike/assets_raw/art/

schema.files: ordered loose frame files (one PNG per frame)
schema.atlas+rects: atlas file with [x,y,w,h] per frame (used only where the pack ships no loose frames)
schema.also_usable_as: other categories the sprite could reasonably serve
schema.character: groups the idle/run/hit animations of one character
schema.content_bbox: [x,y,w,h] union of non-transparent pixels over all frames (Superdark frames sit in padded 32x32 or 64x64 canvases)
schema.show_whole: contact-sheet hint: draw the whole atlas instead of every cell

notes: All character sprites face right only (flip horizontally for left); there are no up/down facings and no attack or death animations in any pack.
0x72 animations: 4 frames idle, 4 frames run, 1 frame hit (heroes only). Superdark: 4 idle + 4 walk (Golem 6+6) or one shared 4-frame loop.
